The loop begins with implementation orchestration and immediately exits only that loop on positive fresh completion of all accepted work/local proof due at the boundary; human external testing and later formal proof/reviews are excluded from that early prerequisite. After each incomplete attempt, attempt a canonical-plan record and a dedicated Jira comment, reporting confirmed/failed/uncertain outcomes honestly; only an evidenced required external action wholly outside tools and authority permits blocked halt, even if recording fails. Otherwise reuse original research, proposal, proposal self-assessment, full-plan save/Jira reconciliation and clean independent review/main adjudication before retrying. Pending review/save never authorizes implementation of an unreviewed revision. No arbitrary iteration or three-no-progress stop/advance rule applies; bounded individual-operation retries, ownership and safe independent recovery remain. Retain recovery and completion publication/ingestion without duplicate empty commits. Each stage assesses its own goals against fresh actual evidence, creates missing work, updates verified gaps or retains satisfactory work, and hands off outcomes and unresolved obligations. Reconcile all remaining required work and proof in the existing numbered Implementation or retrospective Tasks layout, preserving completed work, immutable Jira identities, blockers and applicable evidence. Before implementation research, reconcile applicable selected contract and target instructions in the local plan, retaining equivalents and explicit overrides; external parent story fields remain read-only. At selected-story validation, verify the selected story and branch, and discover tracking capabilities and identities without changing the parent. Reconcile Jira children and each review-occurrence comment before writes. Reconcile merge, publication and ingestion results before repeating side effects. Simple numbered plans remain simple through implementation orchestration and recovery; already structured/resumed plans stay structured. Post-implementation plan conversion normally converts simple plans only after a positive implementation completion decision, before downstream native review/repair/proof loops. Preserve accepted testing restrictions and procedures as scoped non-checkbox prose in relevant simple items/story notes or existing structured Testing sections, carrying them unchanged into structured sections at post-implementation plan conversion; equivalent wording is sufficient and adequate existing wording stays intact. The task-format decision accepts that legitimate prose without a positive testing-item count; missing/empty sections or no tests exist is not an exclusion. Required native retrospective, native implementation/local review and native PR review/repair cycles remain enabled; a human-only testing restriction does not skip a whole child. Retain real target/scope/ownership, active/unknown-writer and no-race safeguards in existing operations. The task-format decision routes only on task format, with the native retrospective when conversion is needed and the retained-format report when format is usable. The native implementation/local review and native PR review are direct native steps when reached; their existing review/repair responsibilities remain. Native inputs remain data, not instruction forwarding. For native workers operating through CodeInfo2, the conditional AGENTS.md hook supplies $CODEINFO_ROOT/codeinfo_markdown/codeinfo2_implement_story/shared.md#codeinfo2-subagent-rules only when their current step permits agent-created delegation; preserve their own role, scope, Git and no-delegation boundaries without launch/load-proof/receipt gates. Forward shared.md’s adapted KISS policy in every applicable ordinary worker/reviewer assignment: no invented workflow receipts, approvals, preflights or checks; remove redundancy only when verified and all acceptance criteria, correctness, existing permissions and required proof remain intact. Human testing remains external/pending, never a pass or missing agent proof. Flow definitions are cached per root: source edits do not hot-reload a running definition. This cache behavior is user information, not a native-launch proof prerequisite. Actual operations retain their safety and ownership checks; invocation is not acceptance proof.
